question: How many functional items are listed in the Eleventh Schedule of the Indian Constitution for Panchayats?
solution:
The correct answer is __**29**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Eleventh Schedule of the Indian Constitution contains **29 functional items** that specify the responsibilities of Panchayats.
 
• These items were added by the **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992**, which came into effect on **24 April 1993**.
 
• The schedule focuses on empowering Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs) to function as units of self-government.
 
• Functional items include areas such as agriculture, rural development, education, health, sanitation, and public distribution systems.
 
• The inclusion of these items aims to decentralize governance and promote community participation in local administration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act:**

 
 
• Passed in 1992, it provided constitutional status to Panchayati Raj Institutions.
 
• Introduced Part IX in the Constitution and added Articles 243 to 243(O).
 
• Mandated the establishment of a three-tier Panchayati Raj system: Gram Panchayat, Panchayat Samiti, and Zilla Parishad.
 
 
 
• **Key Functional Areas in the Eleventh Schedule:**
 
 
• Rural housing, drinking water, roads, and irrigation.
 
• Animal husbandry, fisheries, and minor forest produce.
 
• Non-conventional energy sources, adult education, and public health.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Decentralization:**
 
 
• Enhances grassroots democracy and local self-governance.
 
• Empowers rural communities to participate in decision-making processes.
 
• Promotes accountability, transparency, and efficiency in governance.
 
 
 
• **Balwant Rai Mehta Committee:**
 
 
• Recommended the establishment of Panchayati Raj Institutions in 1957.
 
• Advocated for democratic decentralization to strengthen local governance.
